skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Execute written implementation plans in reviewed batches with progress tracking, verification, checkpoints, and explicit escalation when blockers arise.
skill.summary: Turn a written implementation plan into verified batches with human review checkpoints.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: No static findings required adjudication, and review of SKILL.md found no prompt injection or malicious intent. The prompt-only workflow contains no executable code, network access, secret handling, or external command implementation. It requires critical review, checkpoints, verification, and escalation for blockers before an agent completes a user-provided plan.

content.value_statement: Long implementation plans can drift, hide blockers, and delay review. This skill executes tasks in small verified batches with clear progress reports and feedback checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Loads a written implementation plan and reviews it for concerns before starting.
Executes plan tasks in batches of three by default.
Tracks each task through in-progress and completed states.
Runs the verification steps specified by the plan.
Reports completed work and verification results before waiting for feedback.
limitations: Requires an existing written implementation plan.
Does not design the implementation plan or resolve missing requirements.
Verification quality depends on the plan and available development tools.
Final branch completion requires a referenced sub-skill that is not included here.

use_cases.title: Implement a Prepared Feature Plan
use_cases.description: Execute a prepared feature plan in verified batches while preserving regular review opportunities.

use_cases.title: Supervise Delegated Development
use_cases.description: Review progress and verification evidence after each batch before approving further implementation.

use_cases.title: Control Agent Execution
use_cases.description: Give a coding agent clear stop conditions, progress states, and feedback checkpoints for a long plan.

prompt_templates.title: Execute the First Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute the plan in [plan file]. Review it first, complete the first three tasks, verify results, and report for feedback.
prompt_templates.scenario: Start a prepared implementation plan with the default batch size.

prompt_templates.title: Resume After Feedback
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume [plan file] from [task]. Apply this feedback: [feedback]. Verify the next batch and report blockers before proceeding.
prompt_templates.scenario: Continue implementation after a review checkpoint.

prompt_templates.title: Review Before Execution
prompt_templates.prompt: Critically review [plan file] for dependencies, unclear steps, and verification gaps. Ask questions before executing the first batch.
prompt_templates.scenario: Assess a plan that may contain incomplete or risky instructions.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Controlled Custom Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute [plan file] in batches of [size]. Preserve existing changes, run every verification, and stop on repeated failures or architectural concerns.
prompt_templates.scenario: Control execution of a complex plan with custom checkpoints.

output_examples.input: Execute the payment validation plan and report after the first three tasks.
output_examples.output: Reviewed the plan with no blocking concerns. Completed three tasks, passed the specified checks, and paused for feedback.

output_examples.input: Continue the migration plan, but stop if verification fails repeatedly.
output_examples.output: The next task is paused because the migration check failed twice. The failure details and affected step are ready for review.

output_examples.input: Finish the remaining accessibility plan tasks.
output_examples.output: Completed and verified the remaining tasks. The workflow is ready to move into final branch completion.

best_practices: Provide a complete plan with explicit task order and verification steps.
Review each batch report before authorizing the next batch.
Resolve unclear instructions and repeated failures before continuing.
anti_patterns: Do not begin execution when the plan has unresolved critical gaps.
Do not skip verification to complete a batch faster.
Do not continue through blockers without user clarification.

faq.question: Does this skill create implementation plans?
faq.answer: No. It executes an existing written plan and identifies concerns before starting.

faq.question: How many tasks are executed per batch?
faq.answer: The default batch contains three tasks, unless the user specifies another size.

faq.question: What happens after each batch?
faq.answer: The skill reports completed work and verification results, then waits for feedback.

faq.question: What happens when a task is blocked?
faq.answer: Execution stops, and the skill asks for clarification instead of guessing.

faq.question: Does the skill run tests?
faq.answer: It runs the verification steps specified in the implementation plan.

faq.question: Can it complete an entire plan without review?
faq.answer: No. Its workflow requires review checkpoints between batches and before final branch completion.
